mission.description: Our mission is to build long-term partnerships based on trust, quality, and consistency. We specialize in international procurement, import-export operations, and supply chain management, ensuring that essential products reach global markets with absolute reliability.

story.title: Precision in Every Procurement
story.paragraph1: Aysima Nova Life Sciences was founded on the principle of scientific precision applied to global logistics. We don't just trade; we curate. Every chemical compound, cosmetic ingredient, and pharmaceutical raw material passes through a rigorous vetting process.
story.paragraph2: Our team of industry experts leverages decades of experience in supply chain management to navigate the complexities of international trade, providing our partners with a seamless path from source to destination.

hero.label: Leadership
hero.title: Meet Our Founder
hero.description: A chemist and executive who built Aysima Nova on decades of pharmaceutical industry leadership.

profile.title: Founder Profile
profile.p1: Graduated from the Chemistry Department of the Faculty of Science and Letters at Sakarya University in 2003, the founder began her professional career within the R&D departments of leading global and domestic pharmaceutical companies.
profile.p2: Throughout her career, she specialized in analytical method development, method validation, stability studies, R&D management, and CMC regulatory affairs. Over the years, she held senior leadership positions including R&D Manager, R&D & Quality Control Manager, Qualified Person, and Factory Manager.
profile.p3: With extensive experience in the pharmaceutical and chemical industries, she established Aysima Nova in May 2026 to combine scientific excellence, quality-driven management, and a sustainable business vision under her own corporate philosophy.
profile.p4: Today, the company operates with a strong commitment to quality, reliability, innovation, and scientific integrity.

message.title: Founder's Message
message.p1: At Aysima Nova, we believe that science is not only a discipline, but also a responsibility.
message.p2: After many years of experience within the pharmaceutical and chemical industries — from laboratory operations to executive management — I founded this company with a clear vision: to build a structure grounded in quality, trust, sustainability, and scientific integrity.
message.p3: Our goal is to create long-term value through reliable products, strong business partnerships, and a continuous commitment to innovation.
message.p4: We are dedicated to contributing to the industry with professionalism, ethical standards, and a passion for science.
message.p5: Thank you for being part of our journey.
